question: Does the minority class of each scored CABBAGE cell survive deduplication — i.e. does it carry at least MIN_EFFECTIVE_LINEAGES effective lineages? G8 is the last open label gate on this substrate and currently returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA because nothing supplies `min_effective_lineages`.

the_bar_is_not_restated_here.why_imported: A literal in this file could drift from the gate that owns the verdict. The value is recorded only so a reader knows what it was at freeze time; the runtime bar is always the import.
the_bar_is_not_restated_here.verdict_owner: rejection_gates.g8_dedup_collapses_balance — TRIP if n < bar else PASS; INSUFFICIENT_DATA when n is absent

TRIP_is_a_valid_pre_committed_outcome.statement: A cell whose minority class collapses to fewer than MIN_EFFECTIVE_LINEAGES effective lineages is a FINDING ABOUT THE SUBSTRATE, not a defect to tune away.
TRIP_is_a_valid_pre_committed_outcome.why_this_is_written_down_first: Two of the four cells have minority classes of 61 and 67 isolates, and the provdisjoint Klebsiella x ciprofloxacin R class was 60 isolates that collapsed to roughly 3 lineages. A trip is therefore a live possibility, and pre-committing it is what stops it being re-read afterwards as a bug in the clustering or a reason to relax the threshold.
forbidden_responses_to_a_trip: searching the Mash threshold until the cluster count clears the bar
substituting the portal's pre-computed AMRFinderPlus tree for genome distance

definitional_decision_min_effective_line.decision: min_effective_lineages is the MINORITY class's effective lineage count.
definitional_decision_min_effective_line.basis: G8's own text is 'smallest class has N effective lineages'. In all four cells the minority class is R: 1018, 61, 627 and 67 isolates against majority classes of 3247, 7887, 7205 and 7767.
definitional_decision_min_effective_line.what_is_NOT_measured: The majority class is not separately clustered. It is roughly 100x larger (~26,000 further assemblies across the four cells), and lineage count is NOT monotone in isolate count, so a large S class could in principle collapse further than its R sibling.
definitional_decision_min_effective_line.honest_status: This is a SCOPED READING of the gate, not a proof that the minority class is the true minimum. Recorded here so the scope travels with the number.

method_commitments.clustering: clonality.greedy_representative_clusters_from_matrix — greedy-representative, chaining-resistant. NOT phylogeny.cluster_by_ani, whose single-linkage union-find chains A~B~C into one cluster.
method_commitments.thresholds: FIXED (0.001, 0.005), inherited verbatim from scripts/compute_lineage_metrics.py:50. No search.
method_commitments.why_no_search: variance_ratio = intra/inter tends to 0 as clusters tend to singletons, so MINIMISING it is monotonically biased toward over-splitting; extending the grid downward without an over-split guard picks a degenerate partition. The coarse fixed grid is the documented fix.
method_commitments.distance_source: genome distance via Mash. The portal's pre-computed AMRFinderPlus tree is FORBIDDEN as a lineage proxy — the decoder's prediction is a function of those same determinants, so a determinant-derived partition would manufacture agreement.
method_commitments.incompleteness: A cell whose minority-class assemblies cannot all be resolved is marked partial with n_genomes_missing and emits NO lineage number, leaving G8 at INSUFFICIENT_DATA rather than reporting a figure from a subset.

reporting_commitments: Cluster STRUCTURE ships beside the count: largest_cluster_fraction and discordant_isolate_fraction. A count alone looked healthy in the TB arm while 43 discordant clusters hid 97% of the isolates.
Every cluster-weighted point carries a Wilson interval; a weighted point without one is refused. Weighted N is small, so the interval is the point.
Discordant (mixed-label) clusters are excluded from both class counts and reported separately — never majority-voted.
what_a_PASS_would_NOT_license: Calling these cells lineage-independent external validation. They remain an isolate-level stress test with a disclosed clonality layer.
Treating the `database` column as a BioProject. It is an overlapping aggregator label, so source-concentration on these cells is not this repo's per-BioProject figure.
Any claim about the majority class, which this run does not cluster.
